history.summary: FLAG - IDENTITY UNVERIFIED: no web source confirms any Hindu temple named "Baghmara Shiva Temple" in Baghmara, Meghalaya; identity is provisional and must not be treated as established. The best-supported referent is a generic map listing "Shiv Mandir and Kali Mandir" at about 1.4 km from Baghmara town (coordinates ~25.1928, 90.6445), plus a nearby "Shiv Mandir" map pin about 8.1 miles away at South Garo Hills (~25.1740, 90.5038). These are unverified map pins with no descriptive web coverage, so this file is a thin placeholder for a possible small local Shiva shrine near Baghmara town. Note: a 2025 Lok Sabha question about an ancient Shiva temple in Baghmara refers to Baghmara in DHANBAD, JHARKHAND - not this one - and must not be conflated. District is South Garo Hills (Baghmara is its headquarters); CSV town "Baghmara" accepted as stated but the shrine's exact location is unconfirmed.

town_description: Baghmara is the district headquarters of South Garo Hills, Meghalaya, on the Bangladesh border, about 113 km from Tura. The town has a predominantly Garo (mostly Christian) population with small non-Garo communities.
tradition: Hindu (Shaiva) - provisional, based only on a map listing named "Shiv Mandir and Kali Mandir"; unverified.

travel.airport: Guwahati Airport (~270 km) is the usual gateway; Shillong Airport is an alternative.
travel.railway: No railway station nearby; nearest major station is Guwahati, Assam.
travel.road: Well connected by road from Tura (113 km) and Guwahati; local autos/taxis within Baghmara.
